data.camera: cowboy shot, stepping out from formation on dirt training field
data.description: 【三笠 · 训练兵团操场】训练兵团的操场上，三笠在白制服外系着立体机动装置的束带，从人群中独自走出来，红围巾在风中一动不动般沉静——「训练是为了活下去。仅此而已。」
data.promptProse: Mikasa steps out from the training formation onto the dirt field, wearing her white Training Corps uniform with ODM straps and brown boots. The red scarf rests firmly at her neck in the cowboy view. Other trainees remain behind her in orderly rows, with the drill ground extending between them. Clear field daylight reveals her steady expression and harness fittings, placing short grounded shadows beneath the formation.
data.title: 三笠 · 训练兵团操场
